concepts.def: Nora leaves Torvald and children; modern realism breaks with melodrama; pioneering feminism; door slam heard worldwide.
Russian aristocracy declines; orchard sold to merchant Lopakhin; symbolic of social change; tragicomic.
Verfremdungseffekt (alienation); breaks fourth wall to encourage critical thinking; Mother Courage 1939.
Absurdist; Vladimir and Estragon wait for Godot who never comes; 'nothing happens, twice' (Vivian Mercier).
Pinteresque pauses; three men in attic; menace beneath ordinary; territorial struggle and language games.
Tennessee Williams; Blanche DuBois faces brutal Stanley; Old South vs new America; desire and madness.
